verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents auditor-written policy templates (written by former auditors, not lawyers) and a policy editor with AI-assisted revisions. It also offers reminders for personnel to complete policy acceptance, which implies per-employee acceptance tracking. Nothing in the pack covers policy versioning or approval workflows; the only approve/deny feature is for Trust Center document requests, which is a different capability. Missing for 10: policy version history, policy approval workflow, explicit per-employee acceptance dashboard or records, lawyer-grade (vs auditor) template provenance, independent corroboration.
